ops.text: Notwithstanding the additional restrictions set forth below, Article XX and the section entitled ASSIGNMENT, Licensee may, upon written notice to Licensor, extend the license granted in this Section to its Affiliates, and Licensee may transfer this Agreement and the license granted hereunder to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets upon written notice to Licensor and without Licensor's consent.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a single sentence letting us extend the licence to our Affiliates on written notice and letting Licensee transfer the licence to its successor in an M&A transaction, because as drafted access is limited to our employees (restriction (e)) and Article XX terminates the licence on a Change of Control. This sits at our fallback position on licence scope and transferability.
proposal.summary: Affiliate coverage on written notice and Licensee transfer to an M&A successor
